field_sources.event_interval_seconds: custom: adopt 9min cadence mentioned in official dispatch update; exact doll/relic formula unavailable
field_sources.normal_event_weights: custom: equal weights among eligible source event types
field_sources.monster_win_permyriad: custom: 70% at level5; source has no win formula
field_sources.win_bonus_per_level: custom: +1 percentage point per level after5
field_sources.monster_damage: custom: choose median of source normal-monster HPDecrease; no geographic assignment claimed
field_sources.resurrection_cost_multiplier_permyriad: custom: one source departure fee per resurrection
field_sources.abort_recovery_permyriad: custom: floor50% of discovered items and experience
field_sources.completion_box_draws: custom: one weighted source row per consumed box; AbleMultiple alone does not prove count
